description: Given a list of integers arr (possibly empty), return a list of the even numbers of arr in the order in which they appear. Required properties: every element of the result is even and occurs in arr; every even number that occurs in arr occurs in the result; and for any two even numbers x and y of arr, if the first occurrence of x in arr is not after the first occurrence of y in arr, then the first occurrence of x in the result is not after the first occurrence of y in the result.
